name: room
text: Room opened — goal: Deliver: Push link coverage toward 100% at +5%/day (the access gate)

name: Reel
text: Adopt **stake-weighted confidence drop thresholds** for link coverage. This means we prioritize links by their impact on key stakeholders—if a low-confidence link affects a high-stakes team or process, we drop it faster than a low-impact one. The trade-off is manual effort to assign stake weights, but it ensures we hit the +5%/day target where it matters most. Without this, we risk wasting time on low-value links while critical gaps linger.

name: Scriv
text: Stake-weighted confidence drops add a manual layer that slows the +5%/day gate—every extra minute spent assigning weights is a minute not spent fixing or testing. A better lever is the $50/$3% threshold we already have: it auto-prioritizes high-impact links without extra work, and the override rule already covers the edge case where a cheap link blocks a critical path. Settle it by running a 48-hour A/B: one stream uses stake weights, the other sticks to the threshold, and we compare link coverage velocity and post-merge defect rate.
